promise: Target an uncrewed lunar landing in March 2027, according to reported investor communications
description: Reuters relayed a February 6, 2026 Wall Street Journal report that SpaceX was targeting an uncrewed lunar landing in March 2027. Musk subsequently confirmed lunar priority but not independently the precise landing date.
evidence: WSJ report on SpaceX investor communication, February 6, 2026
Musk posts on X confirming the Moon-first strategy, February 8, 2026

review.note: March target comes from reporting on a SpaceX investor communication, not Musk's February 8 public confirmation of lunar priority. Communication's actual date was not disclosed; February 6 is report date. Preserve anonymous-source provenance and withhold unsupported precise announcement date.

role: Sri Lanka Extended Fund Facility arrangement
promise: Provide Sri Lanka about US$3 billion under a 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement approved in March 2023
description: The IMF approved Sri Lanka's 48-month Extended Fund Facility on March 20, 2023. Disbursements depend on programme reviews.
evidence: The IMF completed combined fifth and sixth reviews on May 27, 2026; the full arrangement remained subject to further implementation.

review.note: IMF confirms March 20, 2023 approval of a 48-month arrangement and subsequent reviews. March 31, 2027 is not established as its legal expiry; do not convert an approximate four-year term to an invented month-end deadline.

role: Federal government led by Prime Minister Mark Carney
promise: Double Canada's preferential trade-market access over the next six months.
description: The Prime Minister's Office stated a six-month market-access target alongside the Canada Investment Summit. The due date is six calendar months after the announcement.
evidence: The official release states the target while describing existing trade agreements and prospective access from ASEAN to India; it does not demonstrate that the expansion has already happened.
